Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.service

Class PromptEvaluationService

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.service.PromptEvaluationService
All Implemented Interfaces:
EvaluatePromptsUseCase
public class PromptEvaluationService extends Object implements EvaluatePromptsUseCase
Application service implementing the prompt evaluation and comparison workflow.

Orchestrates the creation of prompt variants, evaluation of variants against sample articles (summarize + AI-judge scoring), and side-by-side comparisons of multiple variants. All results are persisted for historical review.

This class carries no Spring annotations; AppConfig wires it as a @Bean so the application layer remains framework-free and trivially testable without a Spring context.
